The first release of KamiCreative: a node-based, real-time media environment for live performance, interactive installations and projection mapping.

## Download

**[KamiCreative-Setup-1.0.0.exe](https://github.com/terpenesalad/kamicreative/releases/download/v1.0.0/KamiCreative-Setup-1.0.0.exe)** — Windows 10/11, 64-bit (82 MB)

Run the installer, choose where to install, and start KamiCreative from the Start menu or desktop. The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may ask you to confirm: choose **More info → Run anyway**.


## What's in 1.0.0

- **Patch editor** with inline scrubbable values, quick-add search (double-click or Tab), drop-a-wire-to-add-and-connect, live video previews on every module, full undo/redo, copy/paste and bypass.
- **106 modules**: movie, picture, camera, text, shapes, noise, gradients, patterns and a GLSL shader module; 27 GPU effects (keying, colour, blur, glow, feedback, kaleidoscope, glitch, displace and more); mixers with seven transitions and twelve blend modes; generators, maths, logic and control surfaces.
- **Show control**: MIDI in/out, OSC send/receive, Art-Net DMX out, keyboard, mouse, gamepad, microphone analysis with beat detection.
- **Scenes as cues** with cross-fades, auto-follows and a Live view with a big GO button, cue list, notes and operator controls.
- **Multiple stage outputs** on any display, and a **projection mapper** with perspective corner pin, mesh warps up to 8×8, input regions, soft-edge blending, colour trim and a calibration test pattern.
- **Reliable files**: `.kamic` projects with relative media paths, atomic saves with backup, and crash recovery.
- Six example projects (File → Open Example), a user guide, a module reference and a graphics self-test (Help menu).

Requires a GPU with WebGL 2 support. See the [user guide](https://github.com/terpenesalad/kamicreative/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md) to get started.
